title: Wiki Notion Integration
description: Your published Notion wiki inside Foundry: a draggable "Wiki" button opens a library with a table of contents that follows your Notion pages and linked views, keyword search, GM "featured" pages and per-player favorites. Notion pages open in a viewer, can be shown to players and pinned on scenes. Manual sync: a bookmarklet collects your published site, the GM imports the file. No server, no API key.
